text: I was hurt in a car accident in Hobart. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?

result.keyword: I was hurt in a car accident in Hobart. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?
result.markdown:
Yes. If you were injured in a **car accident in Hobart**, I’d prioritise lawyers who regularly handle Tasmanian **MAIB motor-vehicle injury claims**, rather than a general solicitor.

### My shortlist

1. **Blumers Personal Injury Lawyers** — **my first call**
   - Specialist personal-injury firm that acts for injured people rather than insurers.
   - Their Hobart team specifically handles motor-vehicle injury claims and common-law damages. David Cocker, a Hobart director/principal solicitor, lists motor-vehicle accidents and common-law claims among his practice areas. [www.blumers.com.au](https://www.blumers.com.au/hobart/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Hobart: Level 13, 188 Collins St; **03 6240 4300**. [www.blumers.com.au](https://www.blumers.com.au/team/team-member/christina-tsou/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - [Blumers — motor vehicle accident claims](https://www.blumers.com.au/motor-vehicle-accident/?state=TAS&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

2. **Hall Payne Lawyers Hobart**
   - Strong option for road-accident compensation. Their Hobart team specifically handles Tasmanian motor-vehicle claims, including MAIB and common-law claims.
   - They offer a free initial consultation and say eligible matters may be handled on a no-win-no-fee basis. [hallpayne.com.au](https://hallpayne.com.au/areas-of-practice/personal-injury/tas/road-accidents/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Hobart: Level 6, 45 Murray St; **03 6215 8100**.
   - [Hall Payne — Tasmania motor-vehicle claims](https://hallpayne.com.au/areas-of-practice/personal-injury/tas/road-accidents/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

3. **LHD Lawyers Hobart**
   - Another dedicated compensation practice with a Hobart office.
   - They specifically advertise MAIB claims, treatment/income support and common-law claims following serious injuries, with no-win-no-fee arrangements for eligible matters. [www.lhd.com.au](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/tas/hobart/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
   - Level 2, 86 Collins St; **1800 455 725**.
   - [LHD — Hobart car-accident claims](https://www.lhd.com.au/office-location/tas/hobart/car-accident/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

4. **Tasmanian Compensation Lawyers**
   - Hobart-based practice specifically focused on workers compensation, motor-vehicle accidents and public-liability claims.
   - Worth getting a comparison quote/opinion from them if you want a genuinely local alternative.

### One important thing about Tasmania

Tasmania has a **no-fault MAIB scheme**, so you can generally receive scheduled benefits for an injury from a motor accident regardless of who caused it. If another person was negligent, you may additionally have a **common-law damages claim** for things such as pain and suffering, future medical expenses and loss of earning capacity. [maib.tas.gov.au](https://maib.tas.gov.au/volumes/documents/Brochures/Brochure-Claims-Procedures.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Don't wait too long:** MAIB says an application for scheduled benefits generally needs to be lodged within **12 months** of the accident, and motor accidents involving personal injury must be reported to police. There are shorter deadlines in some circumstances, including unidentified vehicles. [maib.tas.gov.au](https://maib.tas.gov.au/volumes/documents/Brochures/Brochure-Claims-Procedures.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### What I'd do

I'd contact **Blumers and Hall Payne first**, tell both firms the accident date, your injuries, whether you were the driver/passenger/pedestrian, whether another driver was at fault, and whether you've already lodged an MAIB claim. Ask:

- Do I have a potential **common-law claim**, as well as MAIB benefits?
- Will you act **no win, no fee**, and exactly what expenses are excluded?
- What are the applicable deadlines in my circumstances?
- Who will actually handle my case?
- Is there anything I should **not sign or agree to with MAIB/insurers** before you review it?

If you tell me **when the accident happened, whether you were the driver/passenger, and roughly how serious your injuries are**, I can narrow this down to the **2–3 lawyers I'd contact first** and explain what compensation you may potentially be entitled to.
